title: Download Hub: let your NAS do the downloading
body:
Paste a link, close the browser, done. Download Hub downloads files, torrents and online videos straight to your NAS. It keeps going after you sign out. Powered by the official Gopeed engine.

## The big ideas

- **Almost any link.** HTTP/HTTPS, BitTorrent (`.torrent` files and magnet links), ED2K, plus videos from sites supported by yt-dlp.
- **Everyone gets their own list.** Each DSM user has their own downloads, save folder and preferences.
- **Search built in.** Search your sources from inside the app and click **Download**.
- **Admins stay in control.** Admins choose who can use it, plus which extensions and engine updates go in. Updates are verified and can be rolled back.

## 1. Pick where files go

At the top of **Downloads**, **Save to** shows your folder. Click **Change** to pick another one. Files keep saving there in the background, even after you sign out.

![Downloads list](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/55995e0f-5042-40de-b7a3-4ed1cbe00402)

## 2. Add a download

Click **New download** and paste one or more links, one per line. You can also use **Open file** for a `.torrent`. Download Hub sorts the links by type. For torrents you can tick **Choose files after adding** to pick which files you want.

![New download dialog](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ccaacd09-60a2-4aec-944c-13ec94f1c023)

Click **Add**. Pause, resume or filter downloads from the list, or use **Pause all** and **Resume all**.

## 3. Search instead of hunting for links

Open **Search**, type a name and pick a category and sources. The results come from all the sources you chose. Sort them, then click **Download** on the one you want.

![Search results](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a911f57c-a235-497f-85c2-e4985604f3be)

Add your own sources (Torznab, RSS and more) under **Settings › Search**. If a source needs a login, a **Sign in** chip appears next to it.

## 4. Turn on video downloads (admins)

Video and audio downloads use **yt-dlp**. Until it's installed, video links won't download. An admin installs it under **Core updates › Media tools**, along with FFmpeg (for best-quality merges) and Deno (needed for some YouTube formats). They come only from official GitHub stable releases.

![Core updates and media tools](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7a139961-60aa-4ace-b09e-84d02c5d0e79)

On x86_64 NAS models you can also install **gallery-dl** for image galleries.

## Tips & FAQ

**Can I follow a channel?**
Yes. Under **Settings › Media**, follow a channel and Download Hub checks it every 6 hours by default. New uploads get queued as normal downloads. You can also set rules per site, like "save this site's videos into `Videos/YouTube`".

**Extensions?**
**Extensions** lets admins install Gopeed extensions from the official catalog or a GitHub URL. Extensions run in the shared engine and can see every user's download links, so only install ones you trust.

![Extensions](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ca6e60f2-e69f-45fe-882b-fed380519dc6)

**Torrents are slow.**
Allow the BT listening port (default `16889`) for both TCP and UDP in the DSM firewall and on your router. The same goes for the ED2K ports if you use them. You'll find them in **Settings › General**. That's also where you set seeding limits and how many downloads run at once.

![Settings](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/87a5d534-8bcd-4a41-aebc-8436428aa8d5)

**My torrent finished but the file isn't in my folder yet.**
While a torrent is seeding, the file stays in a private staging area. It moves to your folder once seeding stops. Set **Stop seeding at share ratio** or **Stop seeding after** to keep seeding short. With both at 0, files save as soon as the download completes.

**Who can use it?**
Anyone you allow in DSM's **Application Privileges**. Admins manage the engine, extensions and media tools.

**Which NAS models?** x86_64 and aarch64.

---
